scope: Independent agent read and fake-opener tests only; no network, credentials, main() or target calls.
review: Exact original C2 main() and rest_deploy retain frozen-input, checkout, payload, old-live, config, clone, hash, finalize/release checks. Existing NoRedirect opener and request bytes/headers/destination are delegated unchanged. Prior clone read-only; new clone content reuse is decided by provider.
limits: Socket timeout applies per attempt, not a total duration.
Provider release has no atomic compare-and-swap.
Ambiguous release/post-check requires management read before any replay.
